verdict.rationale: The pack shows Snowflake integrates with ETL/ELT tooling (dbt Projects on Snowflake, managed dbt runtimes) and general data-loading mechanisms (Snowpipe, COPY INTO, Iceberg tables for external lakes) with documented setup, but it never documents a first-party/partner connector catalog for specific SaaS apps (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) or databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL) — no Partner Connect, native connectors gallery, or marketplace connector docs are cited. Missing for 10: documented SaaS-app connector catalog, database-source connector docs, partner ETL/ELT integration listings beyond dbt.
